hypotheses.explanation: Charge logs a payment failure and its server span errors. The same trace shows errors propagating through PlaceOrder to frontend checkout, strongly localizing the failure to payment processing.

The failed Charge call takes 44.691 ms at checkout but only 2.904 ms within paymentservice, suggesting transport or client-side delay. This explains additional latency, but not the payment server error itself.
PlaceOrder errors at both server and caller, allowing an orchestration-level exception as an alternative. However, the nested payment failure more directly explains these errors as propagation.
